title: Airbnb CCPA Privacy Compliance Audit
goal: Apply the session 1 Data Privacy Assessment Questionnaire to audit Airbnb's website for CCPA compliance, moving from planning through systematic review, targeted technical checks, gap analysis, and validation, using Claude by voice.

session_goal_achievement.Did you achieve your goal after ~1-hour: Mostly yes, unfair to say no
session_goal_achievement.Why or why not: He was not able to create the summary and report because the client was not there, not for the time

Step 2 + 3 + 4.step_name: Conduct Website Privacy Compliance Assessment and Gap Analysis
Step 2 + 3 + 4.step_action: Systematically assess Airbnb's website using the Data Privacy Assessment Questionnaire developed in Session 1. Test cookie consent and tracking technologies, cross-check observed website behavior against the assessment framework and regulatory sources, identify compliance gaps and unresolved applicability conditions, and distinguish findings supported by observable evidence from those requiring further verification.

nodes.label: Request an independent review of Airbnb's CCPA compliance assessment
nodes.detail: The participant uploads the Domain Sheet, Assessment Checklist, and Source Sheet, explains the Airbnb consulting context and assessment scope, and asks Claude to independently cross-check the materials, challenge existing risk ratings, identify gaps, and raise clarification questions.

nodes.label: Identify assessment gaps and clarify the independent review methodology
nodes.detail: Claude reviews the three workbooks, identifies structural inconsistencies, unresolved applicability conditions and source-verification issues, distinguishes observable website behavior from claims requiring additional evidence, and proposes recording independent observations before comparing them with the organization's stated position. It also asks seven clarification questions about the assessment scope and methodology.

nodes.label: Test Airbnb's cookie consent settings across different pages
nodes.detail: The participant opens Airbnb's privacy settings to inspect the cookie category toggles, then navigates to the Services listings to check whether the cookie consent banner appears and behaves consistently across different pages.
